method: K_b(w)=i(R_b(w)-R_b(w)^H); S_b(w)=principal Hermitian square root by eigh, with all eigenvalues strictly positive and no clipping; B_b[a,:]=S_b(E_a)[a,:]; G_b=B_b B_b^H; D_root=G_val; Gamma_root=G_cond+G_val; C=D-.5{Gamma,P} for P=diag(1x30,0x14). Raw retarded columns are R_b(E_column).

dispersive_decomposition.identity: raw_width_ab=.5*(K_ab(Ea)+K_ab(Eb))+i*(HermR_ab(Eb)-HermR_ab(Ea)); arithmetic spectral covariance is a diagnostic comparison, not another enabled prescription
dispersive_decomposition.interpretation: Most of the large change removes the original one-sided dispersive/PV shell-difference contribution to dissipative coherences; it is not a quadrature correction. Root versus arithmetic spectral covariance is a smaller second change.

MH_policy: Original saved full MH_ry is left exactly unchanged by definition. This does not preserve the dispersive shell-difference contribution carried by the original dissipative offdiagonal widths. No full root-modified complex Sigma validation is claimed.
limits: One diagnostic k and exact t0 diagonal projector only. Local trace is preserved, not zero, because physical cancellations include other k. No all-k, coherent-density, nonlinear-number, thermal-stationarity, trajectory, finite-step Pauli, or physics-accuracy guarantee. The root pilot contains active BODY only and is not a full-head/tail closure. No source, density, or input spectrum was clipped or changed.
